@@ F01 store fe nullif qualified by table
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(NULLIF(repos.fe, ''), $7) WHERE repo_id = $1
@@ F02 alias added
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = COALESCE(NULLIF(r.fe, ''), $7) WHERE r.repo_id = $1
@@ F03 cast added on incoming
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(NULLIF(fe, ''), $7::text) WHERE repo_id = $1
@@ F04 cast on the whole
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(NULLIF(fe, ''), $7)::text WHERE repo_id = $1
@@ F05 dedupOnePair style guard
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $2 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND COALESCE(fe, '') = ''
@@ F06 reordered guard
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $2 WHERE COALESCE(fe, '') = '' AND repo_id = $1
@@ F07 OR guard
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $2 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND (fe IS NULL OR fe = '')
@@ F08 reversed equals guard
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $2 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND '' = COALESCE(fe, '')
@@ F09 guard length
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $2 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND (fe IS NULL OR length(fe) = 0)
@@ F10 guard with cast value
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $2::text WHERE repo_id = $1 AND fe IS NULL
@@ F11 CTE introduced
WITH x AS (SELECT $1::bigint AS id) UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $2 FROM x WHERE r.repo_id = x.id AND r.fe IS NULL
@@ F12 batch fill coalesce from unnest
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = COALESCE(r.fe, sub.v) FROM (SELECT unnest($1::bigint[]) AS id, unnest($2::text[]) AS v) sub WHERE r.repo_id = sub.id
@@ F13 batch fill guarded bare from unnest
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = sub.v FROM (SELECT unnest($1::bigint[]) AS id, unnest($2::text[]) AS v) sub WHERE r.repo_id = sub.id AND r.fe IS NULL
@@ F14 conflict store shape
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = COALESCE(NULLIF(repos.fe, ''), EXCLUDED.fe)
@@ F15 conflict alias
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos AS r (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = COALESCE(NULLIF(r.fe, ''), EXCLUDED.fe)
@@ F16 conflict schema-qualified stored
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = COALESCE(aveloxis_data.repos.fe, EXCLUDED.fe)
@@ F17 conflict nullif both
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = COALESCE(NULLIF(repos.fe, ''), NULLIF(EXCLUDED.fe, ''))
@@ F18 conflict CASE spelling
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = CASE WHEN COALESCE(repos.fe, '') = '' THEN EXCLUDED.fe ELSE repos.fe END
@@ F19 conflict guarded bare in DO UPDATE WHERE
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = EXCLUDED.fe WHERE COALESCE(repos.fe, '') = ''
@@ F20 pn store
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, pn) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET pn = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.pn, ''), repos.pn)
@@ F21 pn param
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET pn = COALESCE(NULLIF($6, ''), pn) WHERE repo_id = $1
@@ F22 pn trim
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET pn = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM($6), ''), pn) WHERE repo_id = $1
@@ F23 pn alias
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos AS r SET pn = COALESCE(NULLIF($6, ''), r.pn) WHERE r.repo_id = $1
@@ F24 pnn conflict
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, pnn) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET pnn = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.pnn, repos.pnn)
@@ F25 pnn cast
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET pnn = COALESCE($2::timestamptz, r.pnn) WHERE r.repo_id = $1
@@ F26 pnn from batch
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET pnn = COALESCE(sub.v, r.pnn) FROM (SELECT unnest($1::bigint[]) AS id, unnest($2::text[]) AS v) sub WHERE r.repo_id = sub.id
@@ F27 g store
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, g) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET g = GREATEST(COALESCE(EXCLUDED.g, repos.g), COALESCE(repos.g, EXCLUDED.g))
@@ F28 g param cast
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET g = GREATEST(COALESCE($9::timestamptz, g), COALESCE(g, $9::timestamptz)) WHERE repo_id = $1
@@ F29 g plain GREATEST (ignores NULLs in PG: same value)
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, g) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET g = GREATEST(repos.g, EXCLUDED.g)
@@ F30 ar excluded
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, ar) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET ar = EXCLUDED.ar
@@ F31 ar excluded with change guard
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, ar) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET ar = EXCLUDED.ar WHERE repos.ar IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.ar
@@ F32 ar now
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = NOW() WHERE repo_id = $1
@@ F33 ar batch store style
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos m SET ar = sub.clean, pnn = COALESCE($4, m.pnn) FROM (SELECT unnest($1::bigint[]) AS msg_id, unnest($2::text[]) AS clean) sub WHERE m.repo_id = sub.msg_id
@@ F34 ar from aggregate of other table (stage9 style)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = sub.last_seen FROM (SELECT repo_id, MAX(last_seen_at) AS last_seen FROM aveloxis_data.other GROUP BY repo_id) sub WHERE r.repo_id = sub.repo_id AND r.ar IS NULL
@@ F35 ar correlated subselect other table
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = (SELECT MAX(o.last_seen_at) FROM aveloxis_data.other o WHERE o.repo_id = r.repo_id) WHERE r.repo_id = $1
@@ F36 ar correlated subselect other table, unaliased bare columns
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = (SELECT MAX(last_seen_at) FROM aveloxis_data.other WHERE other.repo_id = repos.repo_id) WHERE repo_id = $1
@@ F37 ar subselect whose other table has a column of the same name (bare)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = (SELECT MAX(ar) FROM aveloxis_data.other WHERE other.repo_id = $1) WHERE repo_id = $1
@@ F38 ar case on param
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = CASE WHEN $2 = '' THEN NULL ELSE $2 END WHERE repo_id = $1
@@ F39 ar quoted, ONLY, returning
UPDATE ONLY aveloxis_data.repos SET "ar" = $2 WHERE repo_id = $1 RETURNING repo_id
@@ F40 e store
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, e) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET e = LEAST(repos.e, EXCLUDED.e)
@@ F41 e swapped alias
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos AS v (repo_id, e) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET e = LEAST(EXCLUDED.e, v.e)
@@ F42 k store-like
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, k) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET k = CASE WHEN NOT (COALESCE(EXCLUDED.kind, '') <> 'self') THEN repos.k WHEN repos.resolved_at IS NULL THEN repos.k WHEN $3::timestamptz IS NOT NULL THEN $3::timestamptz ELSE NOW() END
@@ F43 k with COALESCE result
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, k) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET k = CASE WHEN repos.resolved_at IS NULL THEN repos.k ELSE COALESCE($3::timestamptz, NOW()) END
@@ F44 k current_timestamp
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, k) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET k = CASE WHEN repos.resolved_at IS NULL THEN repos.k ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END
@@ F45 io insert do nothing
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, io) VALUES ($1, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO NOTHING
@@ F46 io untouched in conflict
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, io, ar) VALUES ($1, NOW(), $2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET ar = EXCLUDED.ar
@@ F47 comment inside
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos -- the stamp
SET ar = NOW() /* always */ WHERE repo_id = $1
@@ F48 delete then insert snapshot
DELETE FROM aveloxis_data.repos WHERE repo_id = $1 AND day = $2
@;
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, day, io) SELECT $1, $2, v FROM unnest($3::text[]) v
@@ F49 temp staging across statements in ONE text
CREATE TEMP TABLE stage (id bigint, v text) ON COMMIT DROP; INSERT INTO stage SELECT * FROM unnest($1::bigint[], $2::text[]); UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = s.v FROM stage s WHERE s.id = r.repo_id
@@ F50 guard IS NULL then additional OR in parens elsewhere
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $2 WHERE fe IS NULL AND (repo_id = $1 OR repo_git = $3)
@@ F51 fe: store UpdateRepoMetadata created_at shape
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(repos.fe, $8) WHERE repo_id = $1
@@ F52 fe with FOR UPDATE CTE lock first
WITH locked AS (SELECT repo_id FROM aveloxis_data.repos WHERE repo_id = $1 FOR UPDATE) UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = COALESCE(r.fe, $2) FROM locked WHERE r.repo_id = locked.repo_id
@@ F53 ar with FOR UPDATE CTE lock first (CTE over target, reads no ar)
WITH locked AS (SELECT repo_id FROM aveloxis_data.repos WHERE repo_id = $1 FOR UPDATE) UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = $2 FROM locked WHERE r.repo_id = locked.repo_id
@@ F54 ar subselect that locks/reads target for another column
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = (SELECT count(*) FROM aveloxis_data.repos x WHERE x.owner = r.owner) WHERE r.repo_id = $1
